description: Recovered previously developed native and self-hosting pipeline from the connected randallb.com site source export; maintained here from this point. Original bootstrap pins and ORIGIN remain unchanged.
adaptations: Native builder defaults to Apple clang on macOS to avoid non-system dylibs.
Native verifier checks macOS architecture and system-only dylib dependencies.
literate/unix-filter.rbel.md and literate/build-native.py establish the maintained literate native example.
Extended self-compiler.bel with fixed-arity function values, generated dispatch, lexical capture, and multi-branch if.
Native builder accepts a generic value adapter and suppresses unused-but-set locals in wasm2c output.
Foundation native verifier and foundation-based literate filter establish higher-order compilation.
Native command with a reader written in literate rbel, sym primitive, compiled example checks, C I/O/process orchestration, and native WABT tools.
Native command relocation, native-seed rebuild, source-reading parity, failure cleanup, and interpreter-free installed build verification.
November 6: authored rbel documentation renamed to lowercase; references and generated bundle docs updated. Imported source record paths above retain their original spelling.
